Create videos from text prompts or animate images using Google’s Gemini
Omni model.

## Problem

You need to generate video content programmatically for social media,
product demos, or creative applications.

<div style={{ 'margin': '0px 20px 0px 20px' }} dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: quartoRawHtml[0] }} />

## Solution

**What’s in this recipe:**

- Generate videos from text prompts
- Animate existing images into videos
- Store prompts and generated videos together

You generate videos with Google’s Gemini Omni model. Computed columns
store each generated video with its prompt. Updating the prompt
regenerates that row’s video.

### Setup


```python
%pip install -qU pixeltable "google-genai>=2.22"
```

```python
import getpass
import os

if 'GEMINI_API_KEY' not in os.environ:
    os.environ['GEMINI_API_KEY'] = getpass.getpass(
        'Google AI Studio API Key: '
    )
```


```python
import pixeltable as pxt
from pixeltable.functions import gemini

# Create a fresh directory
pxt.drop_dir('video_gen_demo', force=True)
pxt.create_dir('video_gen_demo')
```

<pre style={{ 'margin': '-20px 20px 0px 20px', 'padding': '0px', 'background-color': 'transparent', 'color': 'black' }}>
Created&nbsp;directory&nbsp;&#x27;video_gen_demo&#x27;.
&lt;pixeltable.catalog.dir.Dir&nbsp;at&nbsp;0x12d80c190&gt;
</pre>

### Generate videos from text prompts


```python
# Create a table for text-to-video generation
videos = pxt.create_table(
    'video_gen_demo/text_to_video', {'prompt': pxt.String}
)

# Add computed column that generates videos
videos.add_computed_column(
    video=gemini.generate_video(
        videos.prompt,
        model='gemini-omni-1.1-flash',
        config={'aspect_ratio': '16:9', 'resolution': '720p'},
    )
)
```

<pre style={{ 'margin': '-20px 20px 0px 20px', 'padding': '0px', 'background-color': 'transparent', 'color': 'black' }}>
Created&nbsp;table&nbsp;&#x27;text_to_video&#x27;.
Added&nbsp;0&nbsp;column&nbsp;values&nbsp;with&nbsp;0&nbsp;errors&nbsp;in&nbsp;0.00&nbsp;s
No&nbsp;rows&nbsp;affected.
</pre>


```python
# Generate a video from a text prompt
videos.insert(
    [
        {
            'prompt': 'A serene mountain lake at sunrise with mist rising from the water'
        }
    ]
)

# View the result
videos.select(videos.prompt, videos.video).collect()
```

<pre style={{ 'margin': '-20px 20px 0px 20px', 'padding': '0px', 'background-color': 'transparent', 'color': 'black' }}>
Inserted&nbsp;1&nbsp;row&nbsp;with&nbsp;0&nbsp;errors&nbsp;in&nbsp;48.38&nbsp;s&nbsp;(0.02&nbsp;rows/s)
</pre>

### Animate images into videos


```python
# Create a table for image-to-video generation
animated = pxt.create_table(
    'video_gen_demo/image_to_video',
    {'image': pxt.Image, 'description': pxt.String},
)

# Add computed column that animates images
animated.add_computed_column(
    video=gemini.generate_video(
        animated.description,
        images=[animated.image],
        model='gemini-omni-1.1-flash',
        config={'aspect_ratio': '9:16', 'resolution': '720p'},
    )
)
```

<pre style={{ 'margin': '-20px 20px 0px 20px', 'padding': '0px', 'background-color': 'transparent', 'color': 'black' }}>
Created&nbsp;table&nbsp;&#x27;image_to_video&#x27;.
Added&nbsp;0&nbsp;column&nbsp;values&nbsp;with&nbsp;0&nbsp;errors&nbsp;in&nbsp;0.00&nbsp;s
No&nbsp;rows&nbsp;affected.
</pre>


```python
# Animate an image
base_url = 'https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pixeltable/pixeltable/main/docs/resources/images'

animated.insert(
    [
        {
            'image': f'{base_url}/000000000030.jpg',
            'description': 'Beach scene.',
        }
    ]
)

# View the animated result
animated.select(animated.image, animated.video).collect()
```

## Explanation

**Generation modes:**

<div style={{ 'margin': '0px 20px 0px 20px' }} dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: quartoRawHtml[3] }} />

**Gemini Omni model:**

<div style={{ 'margin': '0px 20px 0px 20px' }} dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: quartoRawHtml[4] }} />

**Tips:**

- Prompts work best when descriptive and specific
- Computed columns store generated videos; reading them does not repeat
  generation
- The prompt describes how to animate the reference images
- New rows automatically generate videos on insert

**Requirements:**

- Google AI Studio API key (set `GEMINI_API_KEY`); Gemini Omni requires
  the Gemini Developer API
- `pip install "google-genai>=2.22"`
